name: Jonadab
bio: Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother, was Amnon's friend and cousin, described as "a very shrewd man." When he noticed Amnon growing haggard with infatuation for his half-sister Tamar, Jonadab devised the scheme that led to her assault: Amnon should feign sickness and ask David to send Tamar to prepare food for him by hand, in private (2 Samuel 13:3-5). After Amnon was murdered by Absalom's men in revenge two years later, and a panicked report reached David that all his sons had been killed, it was Jonadab who correctly reassured the king that only Amnon was dead — revealing that he had known of Absalom's plan for the murder from the day Tamar was violated (2 Samuel 13:30-35).
